description: Trinkwasser Stationen Kreis Wesel is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Der Datensatz enthält die Trinkwasser Stationen im Kreis Wesel. Dort ist es möglich mitgebrachte Wasserflaschen kostenlos mit Leitungswasser aufzufüllen. Die Daten werden im Rahmen der Kampagne "Wasserinseln" erhoben und zielen darauf ab, den Einwohnerinnen und Einwohnern im Kreis Wesel in Hitzeperioden einen einfachen Zugang zu Leitungswasser zu ermöglichen. Denn Leitungswasser ist Trinkwasser! Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are alpen, dinslaken, gesundheit, hamminkeln, hitze. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
